items.title: John Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 18, 2023 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer and Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive, but contains no personal or professional interaction details between John Pizzarelli and Monk Rowe beyond the interview itself.

ctx.x: John was interviewed via Zoom on October 18, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and this is a long-delayed Part 2 interview with John Pizzarelli. Do you know that it was twenty — I can’t do the math —
